title: Central extensions of mapping class groups of surfaces from stated skein algebras
summary: Let $Σ$ be a surface of genus $g$ with zero or one boundary component and $n$ marked points, and $H$ a finite-dimensional factorizable ribbon Hopf algebra. We compute the central extension of the mapping class group of $Σ$, associated with a linearization of the projective representation constructed from the stated skein algebra of $Σ$ and $H$. Our proof is purely two-dimensional, and makes no use of TQFT arguments.
